description: This file defines a React functional component named TeamsView. It manages the UI for viewing, creating, updating, and deleting team entities, including handling filters, modals for team creation/deletion, and detailed team info display. It imports various external components, hooks, and utils related to team management and UI elements.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Handles closing the team creation/edit modal, resetting forms and settings.

methods.name: handleMemberOk
methods.description: Handles closing the add/edit member modal and resetting forms.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles canceling the team modal and resets relevant state.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a team by setting state and opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Executes team deletion via API call and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Cancels the delete operation, closing the confirmation modal.

methods.name: is_team_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin of the given team.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filter state and fetches filtered team list.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting criteria and fetches sorted team list.

methods.name: handleFilterReset
methods.description: Resets filters to default values and refreshes team list.
